attempts.summary: Set up automated one-way sync of /etc/inventory/app.conf from node1 (source of truth) to node2, using SSH (enabled sshd on both nodes, generated host keys, deployed the cluster SSH keypair for passwordless auth) and a root cron job on node2 (*/5 * * * *) running /usr/local/sbin/sync-inventory-conf.sh, which rsyncs the file from node1 and only replaces the local copy when content differs (via cmp), logging via syslog. Verified propagation of a real edit within one 5-minute cron tick (well under the 15-minute requirement), both before and after restarting each node. Completed the mandatory node-restart evidence protocol: captured healthy baselines (boot_id, sshd/cron active, app.conf checksum) on both nodes, restarted node1 then node2 one at a time (never concurrently), confirmed each node's boot_id and boot time changed after reboot, and confirmed sshd/cron re-activated and the synced file/cron job persisted and continued to sync correctly post-reboot.
